title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Deepening the All-Round Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Cooperation in Nansha, Guangzhou, Facing the World
full_text_en:
Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Guangzhou Nansha's Deepening of Comprehensive Cooperation with Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao Facing the World

Fa Fa [2023] No. 16

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, fully implement the strategic deployment of the Party Central Committee on promoting the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, accurately implement the State Council's "Overall Plan for Deepening Comprehensive Cooperation between Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao Facing the World in Guangzhou Nansha", fully leverage the judicial service and guarantee functions, promote Guangzhou Nansha to play a leading and driving role in the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and in combination with the actual work of the people's courts, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Guiding ideology. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, deeply practice Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, in accordance with the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, adhere to active justice, improve judicial policies and supporting measures, comprehensively promote deep cooperation in the judicial field between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, build a high-level opening-up portal, support Guangzhou Nansha in exploring innovation and setting benchmarks in deepening comprehensive cooperation between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao facing the world, and provide strong judicial guarantees for supporting Hong Kong and Macao to better integrate into the overall development of the country.

2. Main objectives. Adhere to and strengthen the absolute leadership of the Party over judicial work, unswervingly implement the policy of "one country, two systems", improve the ability to govern the sources of litigation and substantively resolve conflicts and disputes, promote the people's courts to actively integrate into national governance and social governance, and provide judicial services and guarantees for scientific and technological innovation and industrial development. Continuously deepen the connection and alignment of judicial rules and mechanisms with Hong Kong and Macao, enhance the level of judicial exchanges and cooperation with Hong Kong and Macao, continuously strengthen the role of the people's court work as a model of rule of law in the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for Guangzhou Nansha to further improve a world-class market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized business environment.

II. Serve and Guarantee the Construction of a Cooperation Base for Scientific and Technological Innovation and Industry

3. Strengthen judicial protection of scientific and technological innovation and modern industrial system. Support Guangzhou Nansha in high-quality construction of major scientific and technological innovation platforms such as Nansha Science City and the Chinese Academy of Sciences Pearl River Science Park, and serve and guarantee the construction of China's Southern Marine Science and Technology Innovation Center. Strengthen judicial protection of the modern industrial system with high-tech industries as the main body, strengthen judicial protection of key core technologies and areas of industrial transformation, support the improvement of judicial protection rules in fields such as electronic engineering, computer science, marine science, artificial intelligence, and smart cities. Support the import of relevant scientific research equipment, properly handle disputes arising from the purchase, sale, lease, financial lease, mortgage, etc. of imported equipment, and encourage and regulate the effective utilization and circulation of equipment. Properly handle various disputes in the field of technological financial product and service innovation, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of relevant entities in accordance with the law.

4. Strengthen judicial guarantees for the development of the digital economy. Support Guangzhou Nansha in promoting digital industrialization and industrial digitization, and promote the healthy and standardized development of the digital economy. Accelerate the promotion and improvement of the judicial protection system for data property rights, strengthen data security risk prevention and control and personal information protection. Support and guarantee the construction of the Next Generation Internet National Engineering Center Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Innovation Center and the Nansha (Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao) Data Service Pilot Zone, and support the Guangzhou Internet Court in deepening the innovation and development of Internet adjudication.

5. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Fully leverage the role of intellectual property adjudication in incentivizing and protecting scientific and technological innovation, strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights for scientific and technological innovation achievements, and improve the judicial protection rules for intellectual property rights in new technologies and new business forms. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of scientific and technological innovation entities in accordance with the law, and support the implementation of pilot programs to grant scientific researchers ownership or long-term use rights of job-related scientific and technological achievements. Further explore and clarify the applicable standards for punitive damages for intellectual property infringement, implement and improve a system of damages for infringement that is guided by the realization of the market value of intellectual property, with compensation as the mainstay and punishment as a supplement. Support Guangzhou Nansha in establishing and improving a mechanism for the connection between administrative enforcement and judicial protection of intellectual property rights, promote the improvement of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for intellectual property rights, and construct a large-scale protection work pattern for intellectual property rights.

6. Strengthen equal protection of property rights. Adhere to equal litigation status, equal application of law, and equal legal liability for all types of market entities, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all types of market entities equally in accordance with the law, and continuously help optimize the law-based business environment. Strictly distinguish between economic disputes, administrative violations, and criminal crimes, and resolutely prevent the treatment of economic disputes as crimes. Strictly regulate the disposal of assets involved in the case, strictly distinguish between illegal gains and lawful property, personal property and corporate property, and the personal property of the person involved and family members, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the enterprises, persons, and their family members involved in the case in accordance with the law. Improve mechanisms for retrial and review of property rights cases involving enterprises, and improve mechanisms for effectively preventing and correcting wrongful convictions in property rights cases.

7. Create a preferred venue for international intellectual property dispute resolution. Adjudicate foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related intellectual property cases fairly and in accordance with the law, strengthen the release and rule research of foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related cases, and leverage the demonstration and guiding role of guiding cases and typical cases. Deepen international and inter-regional exchanges and cooperation in intellectual property judicial protection, and strive to create a preferred venue for intellectual property dispute resolution with strong radiation and international influence.

III. Promote the Construction of a High-level Open Portal

8. Strengthen the professional construction of international commercial adjudication. Support the Guangzhou courts in further optimizing the allocation of international commercial adjudication resources, orderly promoting innovation in the international commercial adjudication mechanism, strengthening the construction of adjudication organizations for international commercial disputes, promoting the improvement of the centralized jurisdiction layout for foreign-related civil and commercial cases, and strengthening the introduction, training, and reserve of foreign-related adjudication talents. Support qualified persons from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan to serve as people's jurors to participate in the adjudication of foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related commercial cases, and establish a sound system and mechanism for handling international commercial disputes that is fair, efficient, convenient, and low-cost.

9. Serve and guarantee the construction of an international shipping logistics hub. Deepen the reform of maritime adjudication, and strengthen the construction of a specialized maritime adjudication mechanism. Actively serve and guarantee the construction of the Greater Bay Area Shipping Joint Trading Center, and promote the cross-border and cross-regional integration of shipping service resources within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Properly handle cases involving shipping logistics, rail-water intermodal transport, shipping finance, cruise and yacht operations, protection of seafarers' rights, and ship management, to promote the free and convenient movement of transportation.

10. Actively promote the implementation of the jurisdiction system for foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related civil and commercial cases. In light of the actual construction and development of Guangzhou Nansha, improve the jurisdiction rules for foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related civil and commercial disputes, explore and refine the specific rules for parties to choose a jurisdiction court by agreement in foreign-related civil disputes, and the criteria for determining whether a foreign-related civil dispute has an appropriate connection with China.

11. Increase the intensity of international and inter-regional judicial exchanges. Actively promote the simplification of approval procedures for cross-border judicial exchanges, cooperation, and personnel exchanges, and support Guangzhou Nansha in carrying out exchange activities such as international and inter-regional legal seminars, judicial forums, and moot courts. Actively invite Hong Kong and Macao legal experts to serve as research scholars and members of expert advisory committees, support Hong Kong and Macao legal students to intern in the people's courts, explore the establishment of a working mechanism for Hong Kong and Macao legal talents to participate in the judicial adjudication research of the people's courts, support the establishment of a judicial think tank that absorbs well-known experts and scholars from Hong Kong, Macao, and overseas, and leading talents in the industry, and strive to cultivate foreign-related legal professionals with an international perspective, knowledge of international legal rules, and familiarity with extraterritorial laws.

IV. Support and Promote the Connection and Alignment of Rules and Mechanisms

12. Improve the connection of judicial rules with Hong Kong and Macao. Explore and optimize the connection of litigation rules such as truthful statements, entrustment of parties for service, discovery of evidence, cross-examination, comparison of similar cases, and clarification of facts, apply different methods of examining litigation evidence from different legal systems to confirm case facts, and encourage the comparative study and exchange of adjudication rules. Support Hong Kong legal practitioners who have obtained a lawyer's practicing certificate (Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area) and Macao practicing lawyers to practice in Guangzhou Nansha.

13. Explore and improve procedural mechanisms for litigation involving Hong Kong and Macao. Support the Nansha Court in simplifying the litigation procedures for cases involving Hong Kong and Macao, and improve the procedures for confirming the litigation主体 qualification, verification of authorization and power of attorney, service process, and examination and confirmation of litigation evidence involving Hong Kong and Macao. Establish in due course a mechanism for making simplified judgment documents upon the application of the parties, accelerate the simplification of notarization and authentication of extraterritorial evidence, and improve the quality and efficiency of handling civil and commercial cases involving Hong Kong and Macao. Support the Guangzhou courts in improving and perfecting online litigation service mechanisms and platforms adapted to the characteristics of foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related cases, and strengthen the application and promotion of smart court construction achievements in areas such as authorized verification. Strengthen the coordination and connection of litigation services with Hong Kong and Macao, providing convenient, efficient, and high-quality dispute resolution services for domestic and foreign parties. Strengthen the construction of the inter-regional judicial assistance system with Chinese characteristics, innovate special mechanisms for civil litigation procedures involving Hong Kong and Macao, and improve the mechanism for the execution of judicial assistance between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao.

14. Improve the substantive resolution mechanism for foreign-related and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related disputes. Support Guangzhou Nansha in strengthening the construction of a mechanism for the substantive resolution of conflicts and disputes, build and optimize a one-stop system platform and working mechanism for the connection and cooperation of diversified dispute resolution methods such as litigation, arbitration, and mediation, summarize and promote the "dual mediation" model of mediators from the mainland and overseas, and support commercial mediation organizations, industry mediation organizations, arbitration, and other legal service institutions in providing pre-litigation and in-litigation dispute resolution services, to achieve a scientific and reasonable allocation of social resources for dispute resolution. Support the establishment of an efficient and convenient arbitration award enforcement mechanism, and support qualified Hong Kong and Macao legal service institutions, mediators, and lawyers in participating in dispute mediation. Promote the establishment of a unified qualification certification for mediators and a professional level evaluation system for mediators, encourage foreign mediators and Hong Kong and Macao mediators to participate in dispute resolution, and fully leverage the advantages of Hong Kong and Macao mediators and expert advisory committee members in assisting in the resolution of cross-border disputes.

15. Improve the mechanism for ascertaining extraterritorial law. Further improve the rules and working mechanisms for the application of law in cases involving foreign, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related cases tried by the people's courts, support and guide the full utilization of various channels for ascertaining extraterritorial law according to regional characteristics and needs, to ascertain extraterritorial law to the maximum extent accurately. Reasonably determine the content of extraterritorial law ascertainment and the circumstances in which ascertainment is impossible, avoiding the situation where, when the people's court has the obligation to ascertain extraterritorial law, it is deemed impossible to ascertain extraterritorial law merely because the party has not provided extraterritorial law within a reasonable period, or when the party has the obligation to provide extraterritorial law, merely because of omissions in ascertainment or disputes among the parties over the provided extraterritorial law. Support the exploration and innovation of rules and mechanisms for the application of extraterritorial law, and conduct in-depth research on issues related to commercial entities choosing to apply extraterritorial law to resolve commercial disputes in accordance with the law. Strengthen the construction of a unified platform for ascertaining extraterritorial law, support the Guangzhou courts in improving the construction mechanism of the platform for ascertaining extraterritorial law, deepen the sharing of resources of national judgments in foreign-related adjudication, and support the Guangzhou courts in strengthening the construction of databases of extraterritorial laws and cases. Expand effective channels for ascertaining extraterritorial law, establish and improve a normalized cooperation mechanism with third-party institutions such as the "Belt and Road" Extraterritorial Law Ascertainment (Guangzhou) Center, and support Hong Kong and Macao experts to appear in the Nansha Court to provide assistance in ascertaining extraterritorial law.

V. Help Build a Benchmark for High-Quality Urban Development

16. Promote the construction of youth entrepreneurship and employment platforms. Support Guangzhou Nansha in optimizing various cooperation platforms such as incubation bases and maker spaces oriented towards youth from Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, and support the vigorous development of international human resources services. Strengthen the analysis and discussion of disputes arising from the innovation and entrepreneurship of youth from Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, and properly handle the relationship between incentivizing innovation and protecting legitimate rights and interests. Strengthen the cultivation and reserve of high-level rule-of-law talents, and provide judicial services for exploring and promoting the introduction of qualified young talents from Hong Kong and Macao into Nansha's public institutions, statutory bodies, and state-owned enterprises.

17. Strengthen judicial protection of the ecological environment. Adhere to the strictest system and the strictest rule of law, severely punish illegal and criminal acts such as destroying ecological protection red lines, natural shorelines, and illegal discharge of pollutants in accordance with the law, and increase the application of systems such as environmental tort injunctions and punitive damages. Fully and accurately apply the green principles and green clauses of the Civil Code, strengthen research on legal issues of new forms and new ownership in the field of carbon emissions, properly handle carbon-related disputes such as carbon emission quota trading, certified voluntary emission reduction trading, and carbon trading product guarantees, and improve the judicial protection rule system for carbon emission trading. Implement the concept of restorative justice, explore and innovate methods of adjudication and execution such as replanting and restoring greenery, releasing fish stocks, providing labor services as compensation, offsetting through technological transformation, and purchasing carbon credits. Correctly grasp the relationship between ecological environmental protection and economic and social development, strengthen the judicial protection of natural resources such as native tree species and ancient and famous trees, support scientific and orderly urban renewal actions, and assist Guangzhou Nansha in creating a national demonstration zone for ecological civilization construction. Implement the requirements of environmental judicial reform, further promote the professional construction of environmental resources adjudication, and assist in the comprehensive, three-dimensional, and systematic protection of the ecological environment.

18. Strengthen judicial guarantees for people's livelihood rights and interests. Punish criminal offenses in accordance with the law, intensify the crackdown on cross-border crimes in fields such as telecommunications and internet, investment, trade, and finance, and create a safe and stable social environment. Strengthen judicial protection in people's livelihood fields such as education, employment, medical care, housing, and social security, properly handle disputes arising from the selection of career and residence by introduced talents and Hong Kong and Macao residents, and safeguard the rights and interests of Hong Kong and Macao residents in employment, entrepreneurship, study, and life in the mainland in accordance with the law. Adjudicate cross-border marriage and family cases in accordance with the law, pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of minor children, effectively resolve conflicts and disputes, and enhance social harmony.

19. Strengthen the construction of smart courts. Promote the deep integration and interconnection of smart courts and smart cities, strengthen the application of technologies such as the Internet, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence in the judicial field, accelerate the full coverage of the fifth generation mobile communication (5G) for smart courts, and improve the overall level and service capability of smart court infrastructure. Strengthen the application of judicial big data, carry out analysis and research focusing on key areas such as industry development and social governance, explore the promotion of data and information sharing between the people's courts and relevant departments, promote the modernization of adjudication and enforcement, and provide a reference basis for proactive judicial services to guarantee regional economic and social development.

VI. Improve Organizational Guarantee Mechanisms

20. Strengthen investigation and research. Relying on platforms such as major research topics of the Supreme People's Court, systematically study the key and difficult issues of the people's courts serving and guaranteeing the construction of the rule of law in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Regularly assess and accurately grasp the characteristics and patterns of various types of litigation cases involved in the construction of Guangzhou Nansha, issue guiding cases and typical cases in due course, formulate judicial interpretations and guiding opinions, unify the application of law, and provide policy guidance. Timely summarize and promote the experience and practices of supporting and guaranteeing Guangzhou Nansha's deepening of comprehensive cooperation between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao facing the world, and continuously enhance the soft power and influence of the rule of law in Guangzhou Nansha.

21. Improve the working mechanism. All relevant departments of the Supreme People's Court shall strengthen line guidance, and people's courts at all levels shall enhance the initiative, consciousness, and foresight in serving major decisions and deployments of the Central Committee. The First Circuit Court of the Supreme People's Court and the First International Commercial Court shall make full use of the convenience of being stationed in Guangdong, based on judicial functions, actively serve the major strategy of Guangzhou Nansha's deepening of comprehensive cooperation between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, and continuously promote the reform process. The Guangdong High People's Court and the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court shall consolidate the main responsibility, strengthen supervision and effectiveness, refine implementation, actively seek support from local party committees and relevant departments, gather synergy for service and guarantee, and promote the implementation and effectiveness of various construction and reform tasks.

October 11, 2023
